customer_360.description: One row per customer (500 rows). The unified Customer 360 profile with derived metrics.

total_orders.description: Lifetime number of orders. NULL when the source value was missing.

lifetime_value.description: Lifetime revenue from the customer (this IS 'revenue'). NULL when the source value was invalid (negative).

last_order_date.description: Date of the most recent order, YYYY-MM-DD.

last_ticket_date.description: Date of the most recent support ticket, YYYY-MM-DD. NULL if none.

segment.description: Value segment from lifetime_value: Gold > 100000, Silver 50000-100000, Bronze < 50000, Unknown when lifetime_value is NULL.

days_since_last_order.description: Days between last_order_date and the as-of date.

days_since_last_ticket.description: Days between last_ticket_date and the as-of date.

tenure_days.description: Days between registration_date and the as-of date.

risk_score.description: Rule-based churn-risk score 0-100 (higher = riskier). Not a prediction.

risk_band.description: Band of risk_score: Low < 40, Medium 40-64.9, High >= 65.

risk_pts_order_recency.description: Points of risk_score from order recency.

risk_pts_ticket_count.description: Points of risk_score from ticket count.

risk_pts_ticket_recency.description: Points of risk_score from recent tickets.

risk_pts_low_ltv.description: Points of risk_score from low lifetime value.

dq_flags.description: JSON array of data-quality flag codes on this customer, e.g. '["BAD_EMAIL"]'; '[]' when clean. Use LIKE '%CODE%' to filter.

source_system.description: Source systems that had a row for the customer, e.g. 'crm,orders,support'.

rejected_records.description: Data-quality quarantine: source rows that were rejected, plus kept rows whose single bad value was quarantined.

source_row.description: 1-based row position in the source file.

customer_id.description: customer_id on the source row (NULL if it was empty).

action.description: 'rejected' = the whole row was dropped; 'quarantined_value' = the row was kept but one bad value was removed.

business_rules: Revenue means lifetime_value. Revenue totals ignore NULL lifetime_value.
'Rejected records' means rows in rejected_records with action = 'rejected'. Rows with action = 'quarantined_value' are kept customers.
Dates are TEXT 'YYYY-MM-DD'. For 'in the last N days' use the as-of date, not today: e.g. last_order_date >= date('{as_of_date}', '-N days').

examples.question: Who are the top 5 customers by revenue?
examples.sql: SELECT customer_id, name, city, lifetime_value FROM customer_360 WHERE lifetime_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lifetime_value DESC, customer_id LIMIT 5

examples.question: What is the revenue by city?
examples.sql: SELECT city, SUM(lifetime_value) AS total_revenue FROM customer_360 GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

examples.question: How many customers are in each segment?
examples.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer_360 GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC

examples.question: List customers with more than 5 support tickets.
examples.sql: SELECT customer_id, name, support_tickets FROM customer_360 WHERE support_tickets > 5 ORDER BY support_tickets DESC, customer_id

examples.question: Which high-value customers are at risk?
examples.sql: SELECT customer_id, name, city, lifetime_value, risk_score FROM customer_360 WHERE at_risk_vip = 1 ORDER BY risk_score DESC

examples.question: How many customers ordered in the last 60 days?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customer_360 WHERE last_order_date >= date('{as_of_date}', '-60 days')

examples.question: What data quality issues were found?
examples.sql: SELECT rule_codes, action, COUNT(*) AS records FROM rejected_records GROUP BY rule_codes, action ORDER BY records DESC

examples.question: What is the average order value per segment?
examples.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT segment, AVG(avg_order_value) AS aov FROM customer_360 GROUP BY segment) SELECT segment, ROUND(aov, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM s ORDER BY aov DESC
